ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) coverage and 25% low-intensity (black) coverage concentrated in the central peduncle-to-notch axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across both lobes. A central black wedge extends from the peduncle, branching into two tapering dark bands towards the trailing edges. Two isolated, high-contrast dark circular spots are located in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 40-45 degrees and deep penetration relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serration along the distal trailing edges. The right lobe exhibits higher pixel-amplitude variations (irregular peaks) compared to the relatively smoother median section of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges leading towards the median notch; convex curvature on the distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters and textured pixel regions on the far distal tips (left and right), consistent with localized attachment-site scarring. Two distinct dark circular pixels clusters on the right white lobe field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged topography on the far right distal tip, indicating minor tissue loss or heavy barnacle colonization scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique pair of vertically aligned, isolated dark spots on the white ventral surface of the right lobe.
